title: The image-store test kit's fresh() truncates transcode_nodes under live workers, so a worker kept across it is taken for dead and its job rerun (cause of two JS-089 check bugs); give fresh a variant that keeps live workers, or stop every worker before it
notes: Same family as JS-158 (D-042): closed by JS-158 if its fix covers fresh(); otherwise fix when the image-store kit is next touched (JS-140). Closed by D-063: covered by JS-158's fix of the kits' fresh().
